intent: Record as reviewed the fetch consent, message, budget, replay, command and state rules the creation Context enforces and tests.
observable_outcome: get-context creation lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Each new fetch the model asks for waits for the person to confirm that exact URL; an earlier approval never carries over.
Confirming or declining a fetch is refused unless a fetch permission question is pending.
Only http or https URLs with a public host and no credentials can be fetched; a literal private address is refused.
A person's message is refused when blank or longer than 4000 characters.
A session is refused before any database work when its budget is below one model call's cost or above the session ceiling.
Starting a session with an id already used returns that session only for the same message and budget; a different request with the same id is refused as a replay mismatch.
After a creation session's deadline every command except cancel is refused.
A creation session reaches draft_ready only through the model's step; no other transition may produce a draft.
A model reply with more than 12 acceptance criteria is rejected.
